name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After recital U – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: Ub. whereas Russia possesses significantly greater military, economic, and human resources than Ukraine, and the involvement of non-EU countries, which have provided significant supplies of weapons and ammunition to Russia, enabling Russia to sustain a prolonged conflict with greater capacity, underscores the urgent need for peace negotiations to prevent the conflict from expanding and further globalising;
